horoscope: The intense desire to enjoy yourself or celebrate can emerge today, dear Aries, as Mars and Jupiter head into alignment in your sector of joy. Strong emotions, reactions, and opinions tend to push you in a new direction, as the desire to take action is strong now. You can be especially enthusiastic about a special project, hobby, pastime, venture, or love relationship. Healthy, considered risks can pay off now. Do check in with yourself whether what you’re pouring your energy into will genuinely serve you well, as there is some tendency to overdo things. Still, today is about the vision, motivation, and thrill, and perhaps the details will need attention later. You’re not especially content to do ordinary things, and you stand out for who you are and what you create. You also have more courage to express yourself and to go after your heart’s desire. Pleasure-seeking activities and self-expression are in strong focus.

As Mars and Jupiter head into alignment at the bottom of your solar chart, dear Taurus, strong feelings can propel you into exciting plans or activities. Improving and growing are your top priorities right now. You’re courageous, more resolved, and motivated, which can very well get you over a significant emotional hurdle. There may be a situation that involves defending people you love. It’s certainly a transit for being brave with the expression of love and care for the ones you love. A major long-term project or endeavor involving home development and family activities can get a push. You might make creative improvements to your domestic world. Plans and initiatives for having fun and making your accommodations more livable, enjoyable, and pleasantly functional can be in place now.

With Mars and Jupiter heading into alignment in your solar third house, dear Gemini, a conversation, incoming information, or news can get you going. You’re motivated and excited to learn or share. It’s a great time to pour energy into a communications project or personal pursuit. Discussions can be hearty, motivating, and supportive, even if a little dramatic or exaggerated. Do watch for communicating about something too soon or for taking on far too much, however, as this transit is impulsive in nature. Otherwise, enjoy the enterprising spirit and optimism. You not only want to improve your life, but you’re also ready to take the necessary steps to do so. It’s a time to pick yourself up quickly and open up to possibilities while watching that you don’t overshoot.

You have big ideas and plans today, dear Cancer, and there could be a sudden boost in business or with money. A strong motivator emerges now. Confidence runs high, and your enterprising, pioneering nature comes out in a big way. It can be a great time to showcase some of your natural talents. Or you may feel the need to defend your values or worth. Watch out for overdoing things, but with a Mars-Jupiter alignment in play, it can be a good time for windfalls and well-researched speculation. You can feel particularly motivated to improve your life or do something courageous, likely due to strong feelings about money, possessions, or business. As enthusiastic as you are now, there are practical sides to consider, and you’ll have the chance to work with these later, but for now, think big.

With Mars and Jupiter meeting in your sign today, dear Leo, it's an excellent time for your charisma, sense of enterprise, and initiative. You can feel strongly about doing something independently or at your own pace, and taking the lead comes most naturally right now. You have the drive to make your vision a reality. It’s a great time to put more muscle into your current pursuits. You’re also in good form for competition, whether it involves sports, games, or business, and for improving relationships. Because you are somewhat inclined to take on too much or go to excess, make sure what you pursue serves you well. With this in check, it’s a great time to feel your initiative and courage. Those who matter most tend to believe in you fully right now. With Mars in your sign, you’re approaching the world a little more directly and boldly these days, and this is especially the case this week as Mars meets Jupiter.

A Mars-Jupiter transit is in the works, and it's happening in a very private area of your chart, dear Virgo, suggesting a lot is going on under the hood. A buried matter may surface, and strong emotions may compel you to courageously handle a long-standing problem or current situation. Something big is brewing in your private life or within you! If you’ve been feeling unfulfilled, this transit can amplify the unrest, and the resulting discomfort or strong emotions can motivate you to take action. You’re itching to do something, and your inner landscape can be animated, particularly if old issues emerge, and you can work up the resolve to put something behind you. Romantic relationships or attractions, particularly private or secret ones, can energize. Or, this transit is about feeling moved to help someone out. Certainly, it’s a fabulous time to gather ideas and form a game plan for a future project. Channeling all this energy can be tricky, but it can also lead to great feelings of optimism and positivity.

With a Mars-Jupiter conjunction in the works, dear Libra, you'll want to share your ideas and ideals, or you may have inspirational, motivating experiences with friends. Freedom issues can emerge in a relationship, stirring the pot and nudging you into action. Your drive to get something moving is in play, and while feelings can be raw for now, ideally, you can channel them into something genuinely constructive. You may feel a sudden urge to connect with a friend or group, or to take action on something you’ve let slide. Don’t be afraid to take the lead now, and put your increased charisma to good use. It’s an exciting time for connecting, collaborating, and bold and enterprising project ideas. Strong emotions and stirrings can encourage the desire to pursue a cause, goal, or cherished dream.

Your enterprising nature emerges today with energetic, brave Mars heading into alignment with expansive, optimistic Jupiter, dear Scorpio. This conjunction only happens every two years or so, and this time, it energizes your professional sector. It’s a time for greater optimism and enterprise as you think in bigger terms than usual and entertain possibilities. While it’s definitely a time to aim high, avoid going over the top, as bigger is not always better. However, with this in check, it’s a time to recognize your own courage and the desire to improve, advance, and excel, which is empowering. Others are sure to notice you now, even with the Moon's move into your home and family sector. Aim to tap into your vision, motivation, and enthusiasm today.

Your desire for action is stirring today, dear Sagittarius, with Mars heading into alignment with Jupiter. Energy levels expand, and you can readily get fired up over a matter of principle or particular belief, which can motivate you to pursue a new interest. You’re certainly ready for something different and more spirit-refreshing, and you’re especially passionate about your ideas. This transit encourages you to express yourself or take a stand. You might discover ways to expand your horizons or reach. If life has been feeling a little dull recently, this is the boost or reinvigoration you need. A bold new interest, educational path, or adventure may be in the works. Competition is also favored now. For best results, aim to use this transit’s increased creative power wisely.

A Mars-Jupiter conjunction is brewing, dear Capricorn, and it's energizing and motivating. A romance or friendship could heat up now, or a financial matter could gain momentum. Enthusiasm runs high, and it’s your resolve and conviction that are likely to lead you to make important improvements. It’s a powerful time to heal, grow, and move past old hurts or limitations. Certainly, your desire to improve and advance is stirring, and it can motivate you to pour more energy into a special pursuit or relationship, follow your heart, or break free from an attachment that’s been dragging you down. You might gain a clearer understanding of your inner motivations, desires, and ambitions, which can be empowering. There can be a connection, incentive, or motivation to get going on a personal or financial matter. You have emotional fearlessness and courage on your side.

With a powerful Mars-Jupiter conjunction influencing the day, dear Aquarius, you recognize that growth comes from confronting matters! Somebody may very well motivate you to pursue a long-time dream or take charge of your life, or you might team up to get something important done. A relationship can catalyze meaningful change. Events happening now can lead to the discovery that a certain amount of autonomy or activity is excellent for you and your relationships. This strong activity is occurring in your partnership sector, and your relationship goals can be highly motivating. You’re braver, more enthusiastic about pursuing what you want, and hard to resist! The Moon moves into your sign, further amplifying your feelings and desires.

You’re in the mood to do something new, exciting, different, or challenging, dear Pisces, especially with your routines, work, chores, duties, or health pursuits. This motivation comes from Mars and Jupiter’s alignment in your solar sixth house. Freedom issues can emerge and stir the pot. You’re not content to stick with ordinary or dull tasks! Bringing more energy or passion to your daily life seems a priority or necessity right now. You may want to tone down your automatic responses to others’ requests or demands, as they may be on the provocative side, but do look for opportunities to expand in the areas of work, health, or fitness without taking on so much that you overload your schedule. Your enterprising spirit is strong, and finding new meaning in a project or endeavor boosts your motivation levels.
